all: Chinese Government donates 30,000 N95 masks, 700,000 surgical masks, 20,000 protective overalls, 10,000 goggles, and 30,000 gloves to Slovenia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Nanchang Municipal Peoples Government donates masks to City of Maribor Slovenia as part of a 180,000 multinaitonal mask donation scheme for Covid-19 Aid
Jiujiang Municipal Government donates 30,000 disposable surgical masks and 2,000 pairs of medical gloves to the city of Koper, Slovenia for Covid-19 Aid.
Huai'an donates 12,000 medical masks to the city of Maribor, Slovenia for Covid-19 Aid
Harbin donates 500 sets of gowns and 500 goggles to Koroskacerna in Slovenia for Covid-19 Aid
